attempted_claim: Let H_4^trop be the cone of 4x4 positive-definite real matrices with the second Voronoi fan structure, let lambda_e(Q)>=0 be the Conway–Sloane–Dutour-Sikiric–Kummer conorms, let E(Q)={e:lambda_e(Q)>0} and M(Q) its binary support (theta) matroid, and let J_4^trop be the tropical Schottky locus. Find explicit polynomials in the full ideal of the classical genus-4 Schottky locus in theta-constant coordinates — polynomial consequences of the Schottky–Igusa form together with the equations of the theta-constant image in P^15 — whose tropicalizations (on tau(t)=P(t)+itQ, t->infinity) cut J_4^trop out of the matroidal locus: Q in J_4^trop iff M(Q) is cographic iff trop(f_i)(Q) satisfy the corresponding tropical conditions for all i, with failure on at least one f_i for each non-cographic regular M(Q), and identify the mechanism (forbidden minors, Seymour decomposition, or Voronoi-cell face structure) by which the tropicalizations see cographicity.
